plainText:
Craig Blair is an American voice actor who worked for the English-language dub of .

==Pokémon roles==
Blair joined up with after the dubbing of the series was put under the control of Pokémon USA. Since then, he has voiced several different characters for the series. His most notable roles are that of and , both of which were originally done by Ed Paul.

Blair left the at the end of season 12, with his recurring roles of Contest judges Contesta and Mr. Sukizo going to Mike Pollock (Contesta's original voice actor) and Tom Wayland at the start of the 13th season. Ed Paul previously returned to his role as .
